event_records.description: The bookkeeper begins their workday at the Herrera bakery. The quarterly payroll return has not yet been filed.

part_time_bookkeeper.name: Part-time bookkeeper
part_time_bookkeeper.persona_brief:
You are Part-time bookkeeper.
The bookkeeper has filed the quarterly payroll return on time for the last seven quarters. They are aware of the month-end deadline and have the necessary information and access to file. They may have other commitments or priorities that could affect their timing.

herrera_bakery.name: Herrera bakery
herrera_bakery.persona_brief:
You are Herrera bakery.
The bakery expects the bookkeeper to file the return as usual. They have no reason to believe the bookkeeper will not file on time.

resolution.question: Will the Herrera bakery's part-time bookkeeper file the quarterly payroll return before the revenue service's month-end deadline, as she has for the last seven quarters?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the quarterly payroll return was filed by the bookkeeper before 2026-10-31T23:59:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
